flow: perf variants only: perf prologue (see perf_prologue)
variants ba0/cf0/e40/fd0 only: call the first virtual on the field_0x50 object (result ignored), then its 0x10 virtual and store the low byte to field_0x58
variant 84d0 only: skip both virtual calls; field_0x58 is read as stored
if field_0x60 is zero, return with no further change
load the outer vtable 0x10 slot value
known-predicate case (slot value equals 0x51647b0): return if field_0x58 is zero; return if field_0x68 is nonzero
other-predicate case: call the slot virtual on the iterator; return if it returns zero; reload field_0x60 and skip the inline ready and clear checks
call the field_0x50 object 0x18 virtual to obtain the buffer
call the reader with (stack record, buffer, field_0x60, 0)
install the record: field_0x68 from record code, field_0x6c from record subfield, field_0x70 from record detail; the stack record fields are zeroed as moved-from
free the old field_0x70 value with array delete if it is non-null; this free happens after the install
if the installed field_0x68 is nonzero, tail-call the report routine; otherwise return normally

iterator_layout.field_0x00: vtable pointer; its 0x10 slot holds the predicate virtual
iterator_layout.field_0x50: member object pointer; its virtuals 0x10 (ready) and 0x18 (buffer) are used
iterator_layout.field_0x58: ready byte; written from the 0x10 virtual result by ba0/cf0/e40/fd0, read directly by 84d0
iterator_layout.field_0x60: tag width passed to the reader; zero returns without a refresh
iterator_layout.field_0x68: installed record code (u32); the clear gate and the report trigger both read it
iterator_layout.field_0x70: installed record detail pointer; the old value is freed after install
iterator_layout.field_0x78: report context passed to the report routine

observed_quirks: the first virtual result is ignored in all four virtual-call variants
the predicate path skips the inline ready and clear checks that the known-predicate path performs
the old detail buffer is freed after the install, so if the new detail equals the old pointer the installed pointer is freed by the same step
the second array delete in each window targets the already-zeroed moved-from record pointer, so it never fires

steps: if the global slot value is nonzero, call the thread-local getter (PLT 0x56606a0) and discard its result
read the thread-local byte at fs:0 minus 0x10a8; if it is at most 1, skip the rest of the prologue
otherwise call 0x52cd6e0 (role by contract) and increment the thread-local counter
counter field: e40 uses tls_base_minus_0x350_plus_0x150, fd0 uses tls_base_minus_0x350_plus_0x148

predicate.rule: returns true exactly when field_0x58 is nonzero and field_0x68 is zero

interface_observations: a matching tag yields an all-zero record, which installs code 0 and triggers no report
a tag mismatch or parse failure yields a filled record, which installs a nonzero code and triggers the report
reader.role: by contract only; its tag/hash internals are a separate work item

report.role: by contract only; a shared logging routine
